metadata.title: From Cellular Memory to Language Modelling: An Independent Profile, Biological Assessment and Audit of CellAI

creators.name: FILL IN: Family name, Given name

metadata.description: Independent profile, data-mining study, biological assessment and audit of CellAI, a language model built from the biology of non-neural cellular memory (Kukushkin et al., 2024, Nat. Commun. 15:9635). We trace the provenance from the massed-spaced experiment to the code and test the founding protocols on CellAI's own dynamics: the core equation is provably exposure-only and the implemented PDEs show no spacing effect. We then profile the code, recover the raw results, and build count-based baselines under the project's exact data and protocol. The reported text+code champions (7.85-8.04 nats/token) score at the level of a unigram model (7.87-7.91); the best run (E34) gains from a bypass around the cellular core. Every Wave 2-4 result is evaluated on documents ~85% of which were in ancestor checkpoints' training data. Headline figures (966,000x; 125.8M parameters; E20 macro NLL 5.190) are corrected. Produced with AI assistance (Claude Code); see the paper's statements.
